text:
maya: quick heads-up — routing policy changes are only visible in the Rollouts tab today. compliance asked 'who changed this policy and when' and they keep getting bounced between rollout UI and audit exports. we should surface routing-policy diffs directly in the audit trail. cc @omar @jen

omar: +1. API-wise we need routing_policy_id, action (create/update/delete), actor_id, and a stable change_ref so exports can pull the full blob. tenant scoping required.

jen: two concerns: 1) export quotas — full diffs for every small tweak will spike bytes. 2) PII in payloads. proposal: include diff_summary (small text), change_ref -> presigned blob for the full diff, and exposure_level tag.

maya: exactly. UX idea: inline summary (what changed: weight + route targets) + "download full diff" link that points to presigned URL. telemetry: tag events with rollout_id, routing_policy_family, and export_size_bytes.

sam: quick API sketch:
```
{\n  "event_type": "route_policy_change",\n  "routing_policy_id": "rp_123",\n  "actor_id": "u_456",\n  "change_summary": "rebalanced weights from 60/40 to 50/50",\n  "change_ref": "blob_abcdef123",\n  "change_size_bytes": "2345",\n  "exposure_level": "internal",\n  "tenant_id": "t_789"\n}
```
Consumers fetch `/audit/blobs/:change_ref` with short-lived creds.

lex: also include actor_hint (hashed email) so customers can do approximate actor mapping without landing raw emails in exports. and add actor_resolution_status: resolved|pseudonymized. :+1:

infra-bot: deploy: audit-a11y-patch to prod @eng-platform — success 1746012400

omar: retention question from legal: they want 7y retention for routing decisions, but contractors' emails must be redacted after 90 days. how do we represent that in exports?

jen: add retention_policy_id + redaction_flags to event. for sensitive fields, serialize them only in the encrypted blob and omit inline. UI shows "sensitive details omitted" with a downloadable archived bundle for approved requests.

maya: plan: i'll mock console flows (inline summary + download CTA + policy badge). sam, can you add telemetry metrics: export_bytes, presigned_fetch_count, and route_policy_change_event_count? also ensure export generator tags tenant and retention_policy_id.

sam: will PR schema + example NDJSON export (with diff_summary only inline) and add tests for quota accounting. posting draft in #eng-platform in ~30m.

maya: awesome — thanks. leaving this thread as the design anchor.
